title: about
subtitle: a little bit more about me :)
photosIntro: and the rest of the time:

map.title: where i've lived
map.lede: five cities i've actually lived in — not passed through.
map.text: born in inner mongolia; grew up in beijing, chengdu and shanghai; came to hong kong for university and stayed. moving that often taught me to arrive curious and learn the local way first. hong kong is home now.

items.text: a camera comes on every trip — mostly west sichuan on foot: ge'nyen, yading, passes above 4,500 m. photography taught me to wait, look, and frame before pressing anything. hong kong after dark is the home ground.

items.alt: Checking a shot on the camera with the Hong Kong skyline behind
items.caption: hong kong, late

items.text: off the trail: badminton twice a week since school — the habit i've kept longest; classical guitar, where slow practice is the only way; and 崽崽 the cat, who runs the flat and keeps the desk tidy.
